from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance fact extracted from a single financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed this statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash line item as reported (e.g. 'Cash and Cash Equivalents')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the balance as reported in the text")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude scale of the reported number: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance was reported as of")
    excerpt: str = Field(description="A short verbatim snippet anchoring the balance value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_records: list[CashBalanceRecord]
